name: Grain
description: Grain is a meeting-notes platform whose public API reads recordings, highlights, uploads and webhooks.
auth_notes: Personal Access Token and Workspace Access Token sent in the Authorization header; OAuth2 for integrations distributed to other users.
gate_detail: Personal Access Token is generated by the user and available on every plan including Free. Workspace Access Token needs an admin on Business or Enterprise. OAuth2 client registration steps are not described.
api_scope: Read and manage recordings, highlights, tags, sharing, uploads, transcript and video downloads, and webhook events; v2 is current and v1 beta was sunset.
mcp_notes: The developers.grain.com site carries an MCP Docs section and S5 describes an MCP server; no server URL is stated in the sources.
blocker_detail: Workspace-wide access requires admin on Business or Enterprise, but personal tokens work on any plan.

evidence.quote: The Grain API lets you read and manage recordings, highlights, uploads, and more.
A Personal Access Token (PAT) authenticates requests as you, with the same access you have in Grain.
Not for personal API access, which is available on every plan, including Free.
Requires admin access to generate and is available on Business and Enterprise plans.
Users authorize your application directly, and your app receives a token scoped to that user's data.
Point your MCP client at the server URL and approve access in the browser.

issues: MCP server URL and officialness inferred from the vendor developer site's MCP Docs link; no source states the server URL.
How to register an OAuth2 app is not described.
S4 and S6 are about Grain Ledger, a different product, and were ignored.
